newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares push on despite US election caution.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares push on despite US election caution.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Tuesday despite rather limited trading and a generally cautious attitude on the part of investors ahead of the U.S. presidential election result, with dealers generally positive.
"There has been no major volume to fuel the market today but the general undertone is good despite the inhibiting factor of the U.S. presidential election," one dealer said.

The court ruling in the EU case barring government papers from being used by challengers' questioning the constitionality of Denmark's adherence to the Maastricht Treaty had a moderately positive affect on share prices, another dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index closed a solid 1.08 point up at 126.34 in overall bourse turnover of 599 million crowns. The KFX December future rose 1.35 point to 126.85 with 145 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Banks had a good day. Biggest bank Den Danske and its rival Unidanmark both put on seven crowns to close at 426 and 272 crowns respectively.
Novo Nordisk finished the day 10 crowns higher at 970, with Tele Danmark the day's most traded paper with 228,000 shares changing hands to close three up at 292.
SAS Danmark was the next most popular share, ending two crowns up at 70.
